Name: MoreMissions
Description: Lets a Mission Control lance team swap finish every unit when that result has no combat reference. Arms map structures for Combat Patrol. After a map is chosen, the waypoint and dust-off lines name that map's round count. Missing a waypoint fails the contract. Reaching dust-off ends it as a win. guaranteed.json is empty, so Combat Patrol uses the normal contract draw.
